hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in .matchory/*|*/.matchory/*|.editorconfig|*/.editorconfig) echo "$f is generated. Refresh it with: uv run matchory-coding-style sync --preset strict" >&2; exit 2;; esac
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && [ "${f##*.}" = py ] && uv run ruff format --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
